name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=chapter). The '22' is the chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs), not a Ghidra address residue: the function lives at 0x244b6, which bears no relation to 22. Name accurately reflects purpose (Chapter 22 end handler).
purpose: Chapter 22 (遠古呼喚) end handler: places the surviving cast / re-aims camera, runs the post-battle dialog+cutscene sequence, then plays the FD2-unique white->black fade ending and advances current_chapter_id.
logic_summary: Copies three private 16-byte end-scene tables (pos_x/pos_y/facing) onto stack scratch (four dwords each via the prologue copy loops), then calls fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro(pos_x, pos_y, facing, 0, 0xF, 0x48, 0x16, 0x19, 2, 0x10, 0x12) to position chars 0..15 plus NPC slot 0x48 and aim the camera. Runs the post-battle dialog/cutscene sequence: dialog page 4, cutscene event 0x41, dialog page 5, pan cursor/window (0x10,0x10), cutscene event 0x42, dialog page 6, pan cursor/window (0x10,0xE). Then the FD2-unique white->black fade ending: fd2_cast_screen_wide_spell_with_fade centred on the cursor (cursor_screen_y+3, radius 10, 8), a 500-tick hold (fd2_delay_ms(500)), a white-screen flash (memset 0xA0000 to 0xFF over 64000 bytes), fd2_play_palette_fade_to_black(), then a black-screen clear (memset 0xA0000 to 0). Tail (shared with fd2_chapter_14_end's epilogue snippet @ 0x239AC): fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template() then current_chapter_id++. No char is added in the handler; 龍騎士莎拉 joins via an FDFIELD event. Cyclomatic complexity 1 (single straight-line path, no branch).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: positions runtime chars, drives dialog/cutscene playback, mutates VGA framebuffer (0xA0000), persists runtime char templates, increments data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id.

notes: Dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_end_handler_table[22] (xref to 0x244b6 is the DATA ref @ 0x51e3d); 0 direct callers, consistent with the file header and sibling handlers. Source comment block (chend2.c lines 280-296) already accurate, precise, and ASCII-clean (Chinese only for proper names 遠古呼喚/希爾法/龍騎士莎拉) and matches the decompile exactly, so left unchanged. Ghidra plate is more verbose but not contradictory, so left unchanged. The 16-byte tables also appear as const arrays in src (lines 267-278) with a documentation block (lines 259-266); those belong to the data symbols, not to this function, and were not touched.
